summary: The corrected integrated revision resolves the prior release blockers: staff enterprise modules now provide credible read-only depth and patient filtering, the reducer enforces guarded idempotent transitions with smoke coverage, unsupported branded/live/clinical-clearance claims and remote portraits are removed, and role entry plus the staff shell provide keyboard and mobile-adaptive behavior. The verified Maria-to-staff-to-caregiver-to-patient closure journey, privacy projection, approved Gemini design direction, and LOW-risk frontend-only architecture are release-ready for the defined slice.
